new_result.name: QFORM-NULLHUB-PRIVATE-TRANSVERSE-CROSS-v1
new_result.statement: For Q=2(X0+ell·X_L)(g·X_L)+d(beta·X_L)^2 with original independent cap-one coordinates, beta·g=0, ||beta||=1, gamma=||g||>0, split L=J disjoint K with g_K=0. Put b=||beta_J||, rho=||beta_K||, eta=||P_{beta_K^perp}ell_K||. If b*rho*eta>0, then Q has a continuous C0 density and ||p_Q||inf <=3*2^(5/6)(|d|gamma^2 b rho eta)^(-1/3).
new_result.key_identity: For M=g_J ell_K^T+d beta_J beta_K^T, the product of its two nonzero singular values is |d| gamma b rho eta.
